compact_artifact_anchor.verification: Verify every included artifact against the per-file SHA256 recorded by this anchored manifest.

project_cpu_safe_complement.deselection_reason: Both tests attest historical R2l/R2m frozen tree identity and intentionally fail closed on the later A4 successor tree; they are not A4 runtime regressions.

read_only_post_block_diagnostic.root_cause: historical first-four choice projection omitted the materialized ARC E option while the production formatter rendered the complete choice list

e0_design.role: instrumentation-validated mechanism audit, topology audit, and centered-lambda sweep

e1_pilot.role: future exploratory mechanism pilot after a prospective single-operator freeze

instrumentation_contract.query_variance_axis: answer queries across the full capture, not q_length within a single decode forward
hard_gate: all formula and synthetic oracles pass
instrumentation ON and OFF are equivalent
multi-step accumulation is not overwritten by the final forward
invalid candidate probability and gradient are exactly zero

mechanism_audit.query_population: teacher-forced query t iff labels[t+1] != -100 within the complete canonical assistant response
mechanism_audit.primary_diagnostic: sum token log-probability within complete response, then distinct-content-group-equal Delta log p(y*)
mechanism_audit.end_task_accuracy_contract: E0-compatible deterministic generated-answer correctness counted once per distinct content group; never teacher-forced token argmax accuracy

geometry_taps.source: after legal source candidate gather and before projector/fuser
geometry_taps.fused: after candidate-specific projector/fuser and legacy confidence/gate, before A-collapse and centered-lambda
geometry_taps.head_reduction: full head-by-feature Frobenius scalar; no sender/receiver head pairing

mechanism_audit.runtime_topology_contract: certified_slot0_v1 with candidate_window=0 implies every retained runtime m>=2 functional row is partition_compositional; other strata live only in a separate raw-to-runtime topology ledger

centered_lambda_contract.logit: z(lambda)_tij = dot(q_t, K(lambda)_ij) / sqrt(d) + parent_bias + parent_mask + log(A_ij)
centered_lambda_contract.normalization: native atoms and every legal child atom share one global softmax denominator
centered_lambda_contract.lambda_2_role: extrapolative diagnostic only; not an approved training operator
centered_lambda_contract.m_le_1_contract: equal to C_post for every lambda
centered_lambda_contract.fixed_checkpoint_evidence_class: mechanistic headroom diagnostic, not matched-training or confirmatory evidence

source_snapshot.construction: the clean pushed A4 successor commit git archive created only after synthetic GO; superseded/failed 744a943, d1698177, and 612697df archives are never reused
source_snapshot.receipt: commit SHA + Git tree OID + ls-tree mode/blob/path + archive bytes + mounted-tree SHA

post_resource_ceiling_review.ceiling_role: engineering memory-integrity guard, not scientific effect threshold
post_resource_ceiling_review.recommended_candidate: representation-preserving deterministic bounded streaming with exact logical-row coverage and chunk-partition equivalence

checkpoint_contract.cross_check: each final projector set byte-identical to the same attempt checkpoint-64 projector set

claim_boundary: Instrumentation correctness is not real-data mechanism activation.
Candidate dispersion is not query-time separability.
Query-varying posterior is not task improvement.
A positive centered-lambda fixed-checkpoint response is headroom evidence only, not matched-training evidence.
E1-pilot is exploratory and never confirmatory-eligible.
Any conclusion is limited to the TinyLlama-to-Qwen3 E0 checkpoints and frozen development population.
